methods.voids: Every actual source and native triangle versus complete box by separating axes, plus closed-solid midpoint containment. Full box checked; 0.2 micrometre inward inset classifies boundary contact only. Supplemental rays never substitute for volume tests.
methods.motion: Actual closed convex semantic solids or exact axial cap-prism decomposition. Linear programming maximizes shared interior radius with every fixed convex piece across continuous t in [0,1], including t=0 and the first millimetre; zero-radius support contact distinguished from material intrusion. Native actual hierarchy ownership and exact per-triangle correspondence bind the same complete translation proof to export.

limits: Component geometry only; no host placement, room adjacency, audience route, species or cart fit, engine/collision implementation, ergonomics, mechanism, load or certification acceptance.
Panel removal requires the declared tool release and hand support. Translation geometry does not model that operation or an actor holding the panel.
Actual access GLBs are independently matched to complete transformations of the closed source hierarchy. They are geometric terminal states, not implemented runtime animations.
Supports, finish collisions, UVs, source-only rebuild, and visual imported captures are independently reviewed elsewhere.
Numerical tolerance is0.0000002m; continuous proof is limited to declared rigid +Y translations and these exact hashes.
